title: Edit form: every field of an event, one form in the panel and the popover
steps: With -UseFakeData -UseFakeCalendar open Calendar (2) and click one of your own morning events
Change the title, turn on All-day, set the end date two days later, pick another time zone, add a guest (mark Optional), turn on Google Meet, add a reminder, set Free, a visibility and a colour
Press Save (or Cmd+Return), choose Don't send or Send to guests when asked, then press Cmd+Z once
Press n for a new event and compare the fields with the card
expected: The popover and the new-event panel show the same form with the same fields. Save changes only what you edited; with guests it waits a few seconds (Undo stops it) and the choice is preselected to Send to guests only when the guests or the time changed. Cmd+Z puts the event back.
